verdict.summary: The new gate correctly compares immediate crates/ Cargo.toml directories against floor rows and explicit declarations, rejects untracked crates, stale declarations, and orphan floor rows, and is wired into the no-compile CI job. The focused self-tests exercise each failure mode plus the end-to-end floor-file/tree path; the repository's real --check-untracked invocation also passes with a complete 68-crate accounting. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defects were found in the diff.
